text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate for /v1/chat.generate in prod-us-west (spike >15% over 90s)

jamal (on-call): Acked. Pulling logs and tracing. Swapping to follow-up channel when we have root cause.

jamal (on-call): Quick heads-up — we pushed autoscaler tuning yesterday for serving-node pool; seeing sudden scale-down events and a correlated spike in request queue timeouts.

deploy-bot: Recent deploy: serving-autoscaler-tune@2026-03-30T22:48Z, rollout 100% us-west.

priya (sre-lead): Jamal please estimate customer-facing impact (approx requests failing/min, & top affected customers). We need to page CS and finance.

jamal (on-call): Baseline us-west p95 rps ~1.8k. During spike errors ~18% ~= 320rps failing. Top affected tenants from quick query: betatech, nova-ads, spincloud.

meera (customer-success): Pinged BetaTech (contact: rachel@betatech) — they reported higher latency since ~03:11 UTC and some timeouts. They sampled and saw ~8% failed; their traffic mostly in us-west.

jamal (on-call): Mitigation: pin autoscaler min_replicas to 6 to stop flapping, and add temporary traffic-shaper to smooth bursts.

jamal (on-call): Commands I ran:
```
redwood infra scale --pool serving-node-usw --min 6
redwood routing throttle --route /v1/chat.generate --region us-west --burst 1200 --rate 1600
```

deploy-bot: Scale & throttle operations requested. Expected convergence ~40s.

jamal (on-call): After actions, 5xx down to ~4.2% and falling. Queues draining.

priya (sre-lead): Good. Create incident ticket and postmortem calendar. Who can facilitate? Jamal you took charge of initial notes, but need a neutral facilitator.

jamal (on-call): I can take timeline & logs. Theo can facilitate?

theo (eng-runtime): I can facilitate tomorrow (2026-04-04 14:00 UTC). Adding eng-runtime and eng-platform.

priya (sre-lead): Add finance & CS for SLA conversation. Meera please compile per-customer impact. Lisa (finance) looped.

lisa (finance): Please provide: outage window (ISO), per-customer request counts & failed token counts, SLA attachments. We'll calculate credit and cost impacts. Also provide invoice cycle IDs — we may issue one-off credit or adjust next invoice.

meera (customer-success): Capturing BetaTech impact: client-side timestamps indicate degraded calls between 2026-04-03T03:10:55Z and 2026-04-03T03:36:10Z. I'll pull their sample logs and ask for permission to share counts.

jamal (on-call): Metrics export link (private): https://internal.metrics/exports/1842004322_usw_spike.csv — includes per-tenant request & 5xx counts. Query used:
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) AS reqs, sum(is_5xx) AS failures, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM requests
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-04-03T03:10:00Z' AND '2026-04-03T03:40:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```

lisa (finance): Received export. We'll run credit calc and post preliminary numbers tomorrow EOD PST. We need invoice run ID(s) for affected accounts. Meera pls flag invoice cycles for BetaTech & Nova-Ads.

theo (eng-runtime): Initial triage: autoscaler aggressively removed spare replicas because of a mis-evaluated healthy-pod metric after the kernel upgrade; when load jumped it couldn't spin up fast enough => queue overflow => gateway timeouts. Opening INF-2026-420 to track runtime fix.

priya (sre-lead): Action items getting logged:
- A1: Root cause RCA (owner: eng-runtime/theo, due: 2026-04-08)
- A2: Autoscaler safety defaults & alerts (owner: eng-platform, due: 2026-04-15)
- A3: Throttle/ingress smoothing as standard mitigation (owner: eng-sre/jamal, due: 2026-04-10)
- A4: Customer comms draft + billing calc (owner: meera & lisa, due: 2026-04-05)
- A5: Postmortem doc + link tickets (owner: theo, due: 2026-04-06)

meera (customer-success): Draft customer note idea: short apology, what happened in plain language (autoscaler removed capacity after recent kernel patch), mitigation we took, when to expect fix, and how we'll credit. Will attach finance calc once approved.

lisa (finance): Preliminary approach for SLA credits: we bill by token. If SLA breach is verified, we propose: pro-rated credit equivalent to the billed token charges during outage window for affected tenants, plus a goodwill one-off credit in cases with significant revenue impact. We'll calculate per-tenant totals and share next steps.

jamal (on-call): Incident closed in monitoring at 2026-04-03T03:36:10Z. Incident-bot closing shortly.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: Elevated 5xx for /v1/chat.generate in prod-us-west cleared at 2026-04-03T03:36:10Z (duration 25m15s).

lisa (finance): Quick heads up — initial credit estimate (preliminary, subject to verification): BetaTech ~ $2,300, Nova-Ads ~ $1,600, SpinCloud ~ $480. Total ballpark ~$4,380. We'll post exact calc + invoice IDs by tomorrow EOD PST.

priya (sre-lead): Thanks. Once finance posts numbers, I'll review the customer-facing note before send. Also schedule a short async update for CSMs to coordinate messages.

theo (eng-runtime): INF-2026-420 opened ("autoscaler healthy-check misread after kernel bump -> replica premature scale down"). Added logs and stack traces. Also creating follow-up INF-2026-421 for a test harness to validate autoscaler upgrades.

meera (customer-success): I've scheduled the postmortem invite: "PM: Autoscaler spike -> SLA follow-up" 2026-04-04T14:00Z. Invited BetaTech (Rachel) as optional observer and legal on standby.

postmortem-bot: Postmortem doc created: https://redwood.docs/postmortems/INF-2026-420. Please add timeline, logs, and link tickets.

lisa (finance): Once we finalize numbers we'll need an approval thread for credits > $1k. Priya pls route approvals to finance-approvers group.

priya (sre-lead): Will do. Thanks everyone — excellent coordination. Keep updates in this thread for audit.

meera (customer-success): I'll prepare the customer note template and wait for finance numbers. Tagging this thread when ready for review. :white_check_mark:

jamal (on-call): Moving residual follow-ups to #postmortems and INF-2026-420 ticket. Leaving the channel for on-call rotation.

priya (sre-lead): Closing the incident thread for now. finance & CS ping here when ready for approvals.

lisa (finance): Preliminary credit calc posted in the ticket (BILL-2026-58). Linking invoices: INV-2026-1074, INV-2026-1081. Will request approvals if adjustments needed.

meera (customer-success): Received. Drafted customer note pending priya sign-off.

priya (sre-lead): Approved. Lisa, please proceed with issuing credits and share ledger entries for bookkeeping.

lisa (finance): Credits issued as of 2026-04-05T18:23Z. Ledger refs: CR-2026-4401, CR-2026-4402, CR-2026-4403. Notifying accounting.

meera (customer-success): Sent customer communication to BetaTech with credit summary and link to postmortem. They acknowledged receipt and appreciated the transparency.

priya (sre-lead): Great outcome. Close follow-ups once INF-2026-420 actions are complete. Thanks all for quick response. :clap:
